PR #57041 is up and ready for approval: sgarces/rcs_28638_c109myr_mapping → main

Root cause:

  • x_prooftype, x_financialstatementdate, x_registrantname, x_registernumber were hardcoded NULL stubs left over from onboarding — never wired to real source data.

  • orderno was missing pyardm's highest-priority COALESCE term (LineItem SupplementalData/CUSTOMER_ORDER_NUMBER), a distinct XML node from the header-level CustomerOrderNumber that was already mapped.

Fix:

  • flat_tlogs_lineitem.sql — extract the 6 previously-unread SupplementalData fields off the LineItem block.

  • map_ardm_header.sql — extend the orderno COALESCE to pyardm's priority order, add a new header_ext_agg CTE, and replace the four NULL stubs with real parsed/coalesced values (ecom branch still emits NULL, matching pyardm).

Follow-up finding & resolution: after the code fix, the customer flagged 43 transactions still showing blank Financial Statement Date. Root-cause analysis (cross-checked via an Opus deep-dive) confirmed this was not a new defect — those rows simply predated the fix and had never been rebuilt. Ran a scoped REBUILD_RANGE (ardm_header + ardm_json only, 2026-07-17 to 2026-08-10) to reprocess the historical window.

Verified end-to-end:

  • Gap closed: 0 rows remaining with blank Financial Statement Date in the affected window (was 17).

  • ardm_json correctly re-baked with the corrected values.

  • No regression on orderno (1013/1013 correctly populated for Customer Order Return transactions).

  • Confirmed the scoped rebuild touched only ardm_header/ardm_json — no other production tables (item, tender, customer, giftcard, loyaltycard, layby, paidin_paidout, reference tables) were altered.
